name: Yukinari
source:
"...I said it didn't I? It's my duty to protect you."

Part of a secret troupe among the vigilante corp of Takamagahara.
He's skilled in onmyouji and is smart and composed.
An old childhood friend of the protagonist, he's like a big brother to her.
